sv.title: Cereno-vd:n avgår som ledamot i Synact Pharma
sv.summary: Bioteknikbolaget Cereno Scientifics vd Sten Sörensen har beslutat att avgå som styrelseledamot i forskningsbolaget Synact Pharma för att fokusera på sina operativa ansvarsområden. Det framgår av ett pressmeddelande.

en.title: Cereno CEO steps down as board member of Synact Pharma
en.summary: Sten Sörensen, CEO of biotech company Cereno Scientific, has decided to resign as a board member of research company Synact Pharma to focus on his operational responsibilities. This is according to a press release.
